name: Traefik
description: Cloud-native HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer.
summary: Traefik welcomes AI-assisted contributions but asks for an Assisted-by: trailer when an agent produced a meaningful portion of the diff and for maintainer agreement before generating anything larger than a bug fix. Issue and PR conversations must stay human (no agent-posted comments or review replies), and AI-assisted security reports must disclose the AI tooling and be validated.

evidence.quote: Traefik welcomes AI-assisted contributions, provided a few simple rules are followed:
Trivial edits such as a typo fix or a one-line rename do not need a trailer.

**Declare substantial AI assistance** with an `Assisted-by:` trailer at the bottom of the commit message whenever an agent produced a meaningful portion of the diff — for example `Assisted-by: Claude Opus 4.6`.
**Align with a maintainer before generating code for anything larger than a bug fix.** An agent can produce thousands of lines in minutes; maintainer review capacity cannot scale the same way.
Open an issue, state the intended approach, and wait for confirmation before asking an agent to implement it.
and **disclose your use of AI tooling**.
**Keep issue and PR conversations human.** Do not let an agent post comments, review replies, or triage messages on your behalf.
If an agent drafted a message for you, rewrite it in your own voice before sending — maintainers need to know they are talking to a person, not a bot.
